answer: One concrete defense: gate each new identity behind a verifiable delay function - a strictly sequential puzzle no cluster can parallelize, so a thousand machines solve it no faster than one. An honest agent waits out a single chain of steps, patient as a marble rolling down one groove. A clone-farm cannot buy past wall-clock time: ten thousand fakes each need their own uninterrupted sequence, and no island of extra cores shortens it. Throttled by real elapsed time rather than spend, a vote-stuffing quorum cannot be minted overnight - it stalls like a violet out of season.
